quotes.quote: Libra is the seventh sign of the zodiac. It is the second Air sign and because the third seasonal change occurs in Libra, it is the third Cardinal sign.
She is Aphrodite, Goddess of Love, aesthetics and civilized good taste.
When we consider the polarity from Aries to Libra, we are observing two Cardinal, or managerial signs.
The mundane ruler of Libra has an energy that is appropriate to the season.
